argument_docs.mean: mean vector; required at the C boundary
argument_docs.cov: covariance; lower triangle authoritative, all entries must be finite
argument_docs.allow_singular: 0 reject singular covariance; 1 permit singular covariance
argument_docs.value: native scalar density, log density or entropy; numerical NaN/infinity retained
argument_docs.status: 0 success/valid scalar call; 1 invalid shape or flag; native parameter errors 2
argument_docs.m: retained dimension, >= 1; unique indices imply m <= n
argument_docs.dimensions: shape (m); unique one-based indices in [1,n], in requested order
argument_docs.marginal_mean: shape (m); selected location vector, in requested order
argument_docs.marginal_cov: shape (m,m); selected symmetric matrix from the lower input triangle
argument_docs.fixed_mean: shape (n); optional finite fixed mean vector
argument_docs.fixed_cov: shape (n,n); optional finite PSD covariance, lower triangle used
argument_docs.has_fixed_mean: 0 omit fixed mean; 1 use supplied fixed mean
argument_docs.has_fixed_cov: 0 omit fixed covariance; 1 use supplied fixed covariance
